mapper.sql: dcc.confirmation_id as "confirmationId", dcc.achievement_id as "achievementId", dcc.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", dcc.department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", dcc.area_code as "areaCode", dcc.confirm_status as "confirmStatus", dcc.previous_status as "previousStatus", dcc.next_status as "nextStatus", dcc.opinion as "opinion", dcc.reason_code as "reasonCode", dcc.processed_by as "processedBy", dcc.processed_at as "processedAt", dcc.change_reason as "changeReason"
mapper.select:
select from department_chair_confirmations dcc
order by dcc.processed_at desc, dcc.confirmation_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select from department_chair_confirmations dcc where dcc.achievement_id = #{achievementId} order by dcc.processed_at desc, dcc.confirmation_id desc limit 1

select count(*) from department_chair_confirm_period_settings p where p.active_yn = 'Y' and p.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and p.organization_code = #{departmentOrganizationCode} and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP between p.start_at and p.end_at
and (p.area_code = #{areaCode} or p.area_code is null)

select count(*) from business_status_transitions where business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and definition_version = 'CONFIRMED' and from_status_code = #{fromStatus} and to_status_code = #{toStatus} and executor_role_code = 'R09'
select count(*) from rejection_reasons where reason_code = #{reasonCode} and business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and active_yn = 'Y'

insert into department_chair_confirmations (achievement_id, evaluation_year, department_organization_code, area_code, confirm_status, previous_status, next_status, opinion, reason_code, processed_by, changed_by, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{achievementId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{departmentOrganizationCode}, #{areaCode}, #{confirmStatus}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{opinion}, #{reasonCode}, #{processedBy}, #{processedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{processedBy}, #{processedBy}) returning confirmation_id as "confirmationId", achievement_id as "achievementId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", department_organization_code as "departmentOrganizationCode", area_code as "areaCode", confirm_status as "confirmStatus", previous_status as "previousStatus", next_status as "nextStatus", opinion as "opinion", reason_code as "reasonCode", processed_by as "processedBy", processed_at as "processedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"
